item.title: Norris doesn’t see an unfair advantage in Mercedes PU
item.description: Lando Norris says McLaren is confident that Mercedes is not breaking any rules by retaining more knowledge about how to operate its power unit at the start of the 2026 season.

item.title: Lapping Shanghai with Zhou Guanyu
item.description: Zhou Guanyu became the first Chinese F1 driver to compete in his home event, so who better than the Cadillac reserve driver to talk us around a lap of the Shanghai International Circuit?

item.title: Gabehart, Spire fire back at Gibbs discovery request
item.description: In filings made Wednesday night to the Western District of North Carolina, Chris Gabehart has asked that Joe Gibbs Racing’s request for expedited discovery be denied because it is “unnecessary, premature and seeks to circumvent” the process.

item.title: Racing on TV, March 12-15, 2026
item.description: Chinese GP, Arlington IndyCar, Vegas NASCAR and more. Here's what's on and when...

item.title: Mustang Sampling rejoins JDC-Miller
item.description: Five years after they won the 12 Hours of Sebring together with a Cadillac, JDC-Miller MotorSports has reunited with Mustang Sampling, which is set to serve as the primary sponsor of the team’s No. 5 Porsche 963 for the rest of the season.

item.title: Solberg storms clear as WRC Safari Rally Kenya delivers mud and drama
item.description: Oliver Solberg surged into an early lead at Safari Rally Kenya on Thursday afternoon, the Toyota driver mastering treacherous conditions to end the opening leg of the WRC’s African classic with a commanding advantage.

item.title: RFK to honor Biffle at Darlington
item.description: RKF Racing announced Thursday it will pay tribute to its former driver, the late Greg Biffle, with throwback paint schemes at Darlington Raceway.

item.title: How single-car Fast Six qualifying will shake things up in Arlington
item.description: The final stage of qualifying for the Java House Grand Prix of Arlington will make use of oval-style single-car qualifying runs, giving drivers and teams new considerations to ponder.

item.title: Mercedes dominates sole Chinese GP practice
item.description: George Russell and Mercedes teammate Kimi Antonelli established a comfortable margin over the field in the sole practice session for the Chinese Grand Prix.

item.title: Russell leads Mercedes Shanghai Sprint front-row lockout
item.description: George Russell led a comfortable Mercedes front-row lockout for the Sprint at the Chinese Grand Prix in Shanghai, although teammate Kimi Antonelli is under threat of a grid penalty for impeding.
